title: ASUS ProArt RTX Spark Laptops now available in the Philippines: Delivering integrated ecosystem of AI agents and creative apps
summary: ASUS Philippines today announced the arrival of the new ProArt P16 and P14, the latest additions to the company’s lineup of high-performance creator laptops. Powered by the groundbreaking NVIDIA RTX…

blocks.text: ASUS Philippines today announced the arrival of the new ProArt P16 and P14, the latest additions to the company’s lineup of high-performance creator laptops. Powered by the groundbreaking NVIDIA RTX Spark platform, which pairs a powerful Blackwell RTX GPU with an ultra-efficient Grace CPU, these laptops are built specifically for the demanding workflows of modern creators and AI developers.

The NVIDIA CUDA ecosystem and an expanding ASUS-exclusive agent-and-application solution make sophisticated local AI easier to deploy, personalize and use. ProArt P16 and P14 unite NVIDIA’s latest AI technology, RTX graphics, and high-capacity memory, allowing creators to handle complex creative projects and run large AI models entirely offline. With ProArt P16 and P14, ASUS provides creators with the power to develop and innovate from anywhere, without the need for constant cloud dependency.
ProArt P16 and P14 Laptop: Creativity on the move

ProArt P16 and P14 redefine the standards for mobile workstations by combining professional AI performance with sleek, CNC-machined designs. The ProArt P16 stands out as the thinnest 16-inch ProArt laptop to date, at just 12.9mm and 1.77kg, while the ProArt P14 offers ultimate portability, measuring 13.9mm and weighing only 1.48kg, making it the lightest ProArt laptop currently available. Despite these slim and light profiles, ASUS has engineered both laptops to sustain high-performance output. They are equipped with high-capacity batteries, offering up to 99Wh for the P16 and 90Wh for the P14, to ensure that creative workflows remain uninterrupted during long days on the move.

Visual fidelity remains a cornerstone of the ProArt experience, and these new models feature stunning ASUS Lumina Pro OLED displays that guarantee absolute color precision. With Delta E<1 accuracy and a remarkable peak brightness of up to 1,600 nits, creators can confidently work in any lighting condition. The integration of a 120Hz variable refresh rate and advanced anti-reflection technology ensures smooth motion and reduced eye strain for the user. The ProArt P16 further elevates the visual experience by supporting up to a 4K display with NVIDIA G-SYNC, while the ProArt P14 delivers crisp, detailed imagery with up to 3K resolution.

Beyond their technical specifications, the P16 and P14 are designed to address the specific needs of modern creators who require a seamless and intuitive mobile studio. Available in sophisticated Nano Black and Neo White finishes, ProArt P16 and P14 offer a professional aesthetic that fits into any creative environment. The inclusion of a comprehensive selection of high-speed I/O ports ensures that users can connect all their essential peripherals and external storage drives without the need for constant dongles. Furthermore, the large, ultra-responsive haptic touchpad provides the precision required for detailed tasks such as photo editing, video timeline navigation, and 3D modeling.

By combining this thoughtful hardware layout with the raw power of RTX Spark, ProArt P16 and P14 ensure that creators eliminate workflow friction, allowing them to focus entirely on their vision and execute complex projects with maximum efficiency.
A new class of personal Windows PCs powered by NVIDIA RTX Spark

The new ProArt P16 and P14 bring powerful, local AI computing to a slim, portable form factor. At the heart of these machines is the NVIDIA RTX Spark platform, which seamlessly integrates the Blackwell RTX GPU and Grace CPU via high-speed NVLink-C2C technology. By combining this architecture with up to 128GB of high-bandwidth unified memory, these laptops deliver up to a petaflop of AI performance. For creators, this means you can now run massive language models, complex 3D scenes, and advanced generative pipelines entirely on your laptop—without waiting for the cloud or worrying about connectivity.

By bringing this level of AI power directly to your desk, these laptops keep your work offline and your data private and secure, while avoiding the unpredictable costs and latency of the cloud. For creators, this means greater control to customize models and build personalized, repeatable workflows. Of course, the cloud still has its place for massive-scale projects, which is why these PCs are designed for flexibility. Whether you need a local, cloud-based, or hybrid approach, you can easily adapt your workflow to match your specific performance, security, and project needs.
ASUS creative ecosystem for Agentic AI workflows

NVIDIA RTX Spark brings NVIDIA AI and RTX graphics together to redefine Windows PCs for creators, and AI developers, all on the Windows platform. Backed by the CUDA ecosystem, it supports a rapidly expanding range of creator applications, AI models and development tools that can run locally with RTX acceleration — creating a highly capable environment for generative AI, model development and AI workflow building.

RTX Spark also removes one of the biggest limitations of conventional PCs: memory capacity. Larger AI models, higher-resolution generation, and more complex workflows can now run locally, opening a new class of possibilities for creators and AI developers. ASUS extends this platform advantage through the layers of its own ecosystem:

Local GenAI, built into ProArt: The MuseTree app integrates two of the best local image models FLUX and WAN for token-free local generative creation, while StoryCube brings AI-powered scene recognition, media organization, and intelligent asset management to Windows.

The best of local and cloud creation: ProArt combines local RTX-powered AI with leading cloud creative services, including Adobe Creative Cloud bundles, giving creators the flexibility to move between local and cloud workflows depending on performance, privacy, and creative needs. An exclusive Google AI bundle further enhances hybrid AI creative experiences.

Zenni Claw: The best ASUS native assistant for everyday AI and productivity that provides deeper integration with ASUS applications and devices for daily tasks, content management and product control.

Open Integration: The platform also supports leading open-source solutions, including ComfyUI for visual AI workflows and Hermes Agent integration with MuseTree for executing complex goals across both platforms.
Precision Control for Creators: The ProArt Mouse MD301

The ProArt Mouse MD301 is engineered to deliver precise, intuitive control for demanding creative workflows, making it the perfect companion to pair with the ProArt P14 and P16 laptops. Built with versatility and performance at its core, the mouse features an ultra-accurate 8000 DPI track-on-glass sensor and a 1000 Hz polling rate across both wired USB and RF 2.4 GHz wireless modes for ultra-responsive feedback. Creators can customize their click feel and extend the mouse’s longevity with exclusive ASUS Push-Fit Sockets for easily swappable switches, while dual-mode navigation allows seamless switching between inputs for effortless timeline scrubbing and large-canvas navigation.
ProArt P16 and P14 RTX Spark availability and pricing

ProArt P16 and P14 creator laptops provide powerful performance tiers tailored to different creative demands. For creators that demand flagship performance on the go, ProArt P16 (H7607BA) features the NVIDIA RTX Spark N1X with 6144-core GPU and 20-core CPU, up to 128GB of LPDDR5X unified memory, and 1TB of SSD storage, starting at PHP 269,995.

For those prioritizing mobility without sacrificing speed, the ProArt P14 (H7407BA) is powered by the NVIDIA RTX Spark N1X with 5120-core GPU and 18-core CPU, 32GB of LPDDR5X unified memory, and 1TB of SSD storage, with an introductory SRP of PHP 224,995.

Customers interested in the new ASUS ProArt P14 and ProArt P16 first-hand can visit ASUS Exclusive Stores at Glorietta, SM Makati, SM Mall of Asia, SM Megamall, and SM North EDSA, where both models are available for hands-on demonstrations and purchase.

For professionals requiring maximum memory capacity, the ASUS ProArt P16 128GB variant is available on a special-order basis. Customers may reach out to or visit any of the participating stores to inquire and place their orders.

Both ProArt laptops include 3 months of Adobe Creative Cloud Subscription, 3 months of Google AI Pro Subscription with 5TB cloud storage, a free Office 2024 Lifetime License, 1-year access to Microsoft 365 Basic with free 100 GB cloud storage, up to 700GB of ASUS Cloud Storage, and the ASUS No.1 Quality and Service package, with a 3-year Local and International Warranty with Local On-Site Support Upgrade, 14-day extended replacement, up to 6x free device cleaning claims, and a 1-year Accidental Damage Protection.
